passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said these words to me.
He called me “Son of man.”
He told me to prophesy against the shepherds of Israel.
He told me to speak to the shepherds.
He told me to say, “This is what the Lord GOD says.”
He said, “Woe to the shepherds of Israel.”
These shepherds only take care of themselves.
They do not care for the people.
The shepherds should feed their flock.
They should not feed only themselves.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־ רוֹעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֩ אֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לָרֹעִ֜ים כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה ה֤וֹי רֹעֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ רֹעִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔ם הֲל֣וֹא הַצֹּ֔אן יִרְע֖וּ הָרֹעִֽים׃

passages.text: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.
passages.sermon:
The shepherds of Israel act selfishly.
They eat the fat.
They wear the wool.
They slaughter the healthy sheep.
They do not feed the flock.
passages.original: אֶת־ הַחֵ֤לֶב תֹּאכֵ֙לוּ֙ וְאֶת־ הַצֶּ֣מֶר תִּלְבָּ֔שׁוּ הַבְּרִיאָ֖ה תִּזְבָּ֑חוּ הַצֹּ֖אן לֹ֥א תִרְעֽוּ׃

passages.text: You have not strengthened the weak, healed the sick, bound up the injured, brought back the strays, or searched for the lost. Instead, you have ruled them with violence and cruelty.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God told Ezekiel to speak against the leaders of Israel.
The leaders of Israel are like shepherds.
The leaders did not help the weak.
The leaders did not heal the sick.
The leaders did not care for the injured.
The leaders did not bring back those who wandered away.
The leaders did not look for those who were lost.
The leaders ruled the people with force.
The leaders treated the people harshly.
passages.original: אֶֽת־ הַנַּחְלוֹת֩ לֹ֨א חִזַּקְתֶּ֜ם וְאֶת־ הַחוֹלָ֣ה לֹֽא־ רִפֵּאתֶ֗ם וְלַנִּשְׁבֶּ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א חֲבַשְׁתֶּ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַנִּדַּ֙חַת֙ לֹ֣א הֲשֵׁבֹתֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ הָאֹבֶ֖דֶת לֹ֣א בִקַּשְׁתֶּ֑ם וּבְחָזְקָ֛ה רְדִיתֶ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם וּבְפָֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: They were scattered for lack of a shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild beasts.
passages.sermon:
The flock had no shepherd.
The flock was scattered.
Wild beasts found the scattered flock.
The wild beasts ate the flock.
passages.original: וַתְּפוּצֶ֖ינָה מִבְּלִ֣י רֹעֶ֑ה וַתִּהְיֶ֧ינָה לְאָכְלָ֛ה לְכָל־ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וַתְּפוּצֶֽינָה׃

passages.text: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. They were scattered over the face of all the earth, with no one to search for them or seek them out.’
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His people.
God calls His people His flock.
God says His flock went astray.
They wandered on every mountain.
They wandered on every high hill.
They were scattered over the whole earth.
No one searched for them.
No one tried to find them.
passages.original: יִשְׁגּ֤וּ צֹאנִי֙ בְּכָל־ הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ גִּבְעָ֣ה רָמָ֑ה וְעַ֨ל כָּל־ פְּנֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָפֹ֣צוּ צֹאנִ֔י וְאֵ֥ין דּוֹרֵ֖שׁ וְאֵ֥ין מְבַקֵּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD: ‘As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because My flock lacks a shepherd and has become prey and food for every wild beast, and because My shepherds did not search for My flock but fed themselves instead, therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD!’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the shepherds.
He says, "Shepherds, listen to the word of the LORD."
The Lord GOD lives forever.
He declares this truth.
My flock has no shepherd.
Because of this, my flock became prey.
Wild animals ate my flock.
There was no shepherd to protect them.
My shepherds did not look for my flock.
The shepherds fed themselves.
They did not feed my flock.
Therefore, shepherds, listen to the word of the LORD.
passages.original: לָכֵ֣ן רֹעִ֔ים שִׁמְע֖וּ אֶת־ דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ חַי־ אָ֜נִי נְאֻ֣ם׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אִם־ לֹ֣א יַ֣עַן הֱיֽוֹת־ צֹאנִ֣י׀ לָבַ֡ז וַתִּֽהְיֶינָה֩ צֹאנִ֨י לְאָכְלָ֜ה לְכָל־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ מֵאֵ֣ין רֹעֶ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ דָרְשׁ֥וּ רֹעַ֖י אֶת־ צֹאנִ֑י וַיִּרְע֤וּ הָֽרֹעִים֙ אוֹתָ֔ם וְאֶת־ צֹאנִ֖י לֹ֥א רָעֽוּ׃ס לָכֵן֙ הָֽרֹעִ֔ים שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand from them My flock and remove them from tending the flock, so that they can no longer feed themselves. For I will deliver My flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, “I am against the shepherds.”
The shepherds are the leaders of Israel.
They have failed to care for My people.
I will hold the shepherds accountable for My flock.
I will take My flock away from them.
The shepherds will not tend My flock anymore.
They will not feed themselves from My flock again.
I will rescue My flock from the shepherds’ mouths.
My flock will not be food for the shepherds any longer.
passages.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י אֶֽל־ הָרֹעִ֜ים וְֽדָרַשְׁתִּ֧י אֶת־ צֹאנִ֣י מִיָּדָ֗ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּים֙ מֵרְע֣וֹת צֹ֔אן וְלֹא־ יִרְע֥וּ ע֛וֹד הָרֹעִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י צֹאנִי֙ מִפִּיהֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֥יןָ לָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD is the subject.
The Lord GOD says this message.
The Lord GOD will act personally.
The Lord GOD will search for His flock.
The Lord GOD will seek out His flock.
passages.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִי־ אָ֕נִי וְדָרַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶת־ צֹאנִ֖י וּבִקַּרְתִּֽים׃

passages.text: As a shepherd looks for his scattered sheep when he is among the flock, so I will look for My flock. I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD is the speaker.
The Lord GOD cares for His people like a shepherd cares for his sheep.
A shepherd looks for his sheep when they are scattered.
The shepherd searches for his sheep among the flock.
In the same way, the Lord GOD will search for His people.
The Lord GOD will look for His people when they are scattered.
The Lord GOD will rescue His people from every place where they are scattered.
His people were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
The Lord GOD will save them from all those places.
passages.original: כְּבַקָּרַת֩ רֹעֶ֨ה עֶדְר֜וֹ בְּיוֹם־ הֱיוֹת֤וֹ בְתוֹךְ־ צֹאנוֹ֙ נִפְרָשׁ֔וֹת כֵּ֖ן אֲבַקֵּ֣ר אֶת־ צֹאנִ֑י וְהִצַּלְתִּ֣י אֶתְהֶ֗ם מִכָּל־ הַמְּקוֹמֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ שָׁ֔ם בְּי֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃

passages.text: I will bring them out from the peoples, gather them from the countries, and bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines, and in all the settlements of the land.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the one true God.
He acts as a shepherd for His people.
He will bring His people out from among the nations.
He will gather His people from all the countries.
He will bring His people into their own land.
He will feed His people on the mountains of Israel.
He will feed them in the valleys.
He will feed them in every settlement of the land.
passages.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֣ים מִן־ הָעַמִּ֗ים וְקִבַּצְתִּים֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וַהֲבִיאֹתִ֖ים אֶל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וּרְעִיתִים֙ אֶל־ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאֲפִיקִ֕ים וּבְכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God is the shepherd of His people Israel.
God will feed His people in good pasture.
The high mountains of Israel will be their grazing land.
God’s people will lie down in a good grazing land.
They will eat in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
passages.original: בְּמִרְעֶה־ טּוֹב֙ אֶרְעֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וּבְהָרֵ֥י מְרֽוֹם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֣ה נְוֵהֶ֑ם שָׁ֤ם תִּרְבַּ֙צְנָה֙ בְּנָ֣וֶה טּ֔וֹב וּמִרְעֶ֥ה שָׁמֵ֛ן תִּרְעֶ֖ינָה אֶל־ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: I will tend My flock and make them lie down, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD is the shepherd.
The Lord GOD tends His flock.
The Lord GOD makes His flock lie down.
passages.original: אֲנִ֨י אֶרְעֶ֤ה צֹאנִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אַרְבִּיצֵ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD is the shepherd of His people.
He cares for His flock.
He will look for the lost.
He will bring back those who have strayed.
He will bind up those who are broken.
He will make the weak strong.
He will destroy those who are sleek and strong.
He will shepherd all with justice.
passages.original: אֶת־ הָאֹבֶ֤דֶת אֲבַקֵּשׁ֙ וְאֶת־ הַנִּדַּ֣חַת אָשִׁ֔יב וְלַנִּשְׁבֶּ֣רֶת אֶחֱבֹ֔שׁ וְאֶת־ הַחוֹלָ֖ה אֲחַזֵּ֑ק וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁמֵנָ֧ה וְאֶת־ הַחֲזָקָ֛ה אַשְׁמִ֖יד אֶרְעֶ֥נָּה בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to His flock.
He says these words to them.
He will judge between one sheep and another sheep.
He will judge between the rams and the goats.
passages.original: וְאַתֵּ֣נָה צֹאנִ֔י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁפֵט֙ בֵּֽין־ שֶׂ֣ה לָשֶׂ֔ה לָאֵילִ֖ים וְלָעַתּוּדִֽים׃

passages.text: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of the pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the flock.
God asks a question.
You eat the good pasture.
Is this not enough for you?
You trample the rest of the pasture with your feet.
You drink clear water.
Is this not enough for you?
You muddy the rest of the water with your feet.
passages.original: הַמְעַ֣ט מִכֶּ֗ם הַמִּרְעֶ֤ה הַטּוֹב֙ תִּרְע֔וּ וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ מִרְעֵיכֶ֔ם תִּרְמְס֖וּ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם וּמִשְׁקַע־ מַ֣יִם תִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וְאֵת֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרִ֔ים בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּרְפֹּשֽׂוּן׃

passages.text: Why must My flock feed on what your feet have trampled, and drink what your feet have muddied?’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to His flock.
He asks a question.
He says, "Why must My flock eat what your feet have trampled?"
He says, "Why must My flock drink what your feet have muddied?"
passages.original: וְצֹאנִ֑י מִרְמַ֤ס רַגְלֵיכֶם֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה וּמִרְפַּ֥שׂ רַגְלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּשְׁתֶּֽינָה׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says to them: ‘Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the people.
He says, “I am here.
I Myself will act.
I will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הִנְנִי־ אָ֕נִי וְשָֽׁפַטְתִּי֙ בֵּֽין־ שֶׂ֣ה בִרְיָ֔ה וּבֵ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה רָזָֽה׃

passages.text: Since you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak ones with your horns until you have scattered them abroad, I will save My flock, and they will no longer be prey. I will judge between one sheep and another.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks to the people of Israel.
Some among you are strong and powerful.
You push others with your sides and shoulders.
You use your horns to strike all the weak ones.
You scatter the weak sheep far away.
I, the Lord, will save My flock.
My flock will not be prey anymore.
I will judge between one sheep and another.
passages.original: יַ֗עַן בְּצַ֤ד וּבְכָתֵף֙ תֶּהְדֹּ֔פוּ וּבְקַרְנֵיכֶ֥ם תְּנַגְּח֖וּ כָּל־ הַנַּחְל֑וֹת עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִיצוֹתֶ֛ם אוֹתָ֖נָה אֶל־ הַחֽוּצָה׃ וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י לְצֹאנִ֔י וְלֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֥ינָה ע֖וֹד לָבַ֑ז וְשָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה לָשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to His people.
God will appoint one shepherd over them.
This shepherd is God's servant David.
David will feed the people.
David will be their shepherd.
passages.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם רֹעֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ וְרָעָ֣ה אֶתְהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת עַבְדִּ֣י דָוִ֑יד ה֚וּא יִרְעֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וְהֽוּא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ן לְרֹעֶֽה׃

passages.text: I, the LORD, will be their God, and My servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will be their God.
David is the LORD’s servant.
David will be a prince among the people.
The LORD has spoken.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְעַבְדִּ֥י דָוִ֖ד נָשִׂ֣יא בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: I will make with them a covenant of peace and rid the land of wild animals, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to make a covenant of peace with them.
God will remove wild animals from the land.
God’s people will live safely in the wilderness.
God’s people will sleep securely in the forests.
passages.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י חַיָּֽה־ רָעָ֖ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיָשְׁב֤וּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ לָבֶ֔טַח וְיָשְׁנ֖וּ בַּיְּעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season—showers of blessing.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will bless His people.
The LORD will bless the places around His holy hill.
The LORD will send rain at the right time.
The LORD will send showers of blessing.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֛ם וּסְבִיב֥וֹת גִּבְעָתִ֖י בְּרָכָ֑ה וְהוֹרַדְתִּ֤י הַגֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ גִּשְׁמֵ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: The trees of the field will give their fruit, and the land will yield its produce; My flock will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke and delivered them from the hands that enslaved them.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God speaks to the house of Israel.
God promises to bless His people.
The trees in the field will give their fruit.
The land will yield its produce.
God’s people will live securely on their land.
God will break the bars of their yoke.
God will deliver them from those who enslaved them.
The people will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָתַן֩ עֵ֨ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה אֶת־ פִּרְי֗וֹ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְהָי֥וּ עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֖ם לָבֶ֑טַח וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּשִׁבְרִי֙ אֶת־ מֹט֣וֹת עֻלָּ֔ם וְהִ֨צַּלְתִּ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד הָעֹבְדִ֥ים בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They will no longer be prey for the nations, and the beasts of the earth will not consume them. They will dwell securely, and no one will frighten them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God promises to protect them.
The nations will not prey on them anymore.
Wild animals will not eat them.
They will live in safety.
No one will make them afraid.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יִהְי֨וּ ע֥וֹד בַּז֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחַיַּ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א תֹאכְלֵ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֥וּ לָבֶ֖טַח וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

passages.text: And I will raise up for them a garden of renown, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God promises to act for them.
God will plant a garden for them.
This garden will be famous.
God’s people will not suffer hunger in the land.
They will not be victims of famine again.
Other nations will not shame them anymore.
God will remove their disgrace among the nations.
passages.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י לָהֶ֛ם מַטָּ֖ע לְשֵׁ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ יִהְי֨וּ ע֜וֹד אֲסֻפֵ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֥וּ ע֖וֹד כְּלִמַּ֥ת הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people,’ declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is God.
The Lord is with His people.
The house of Israel is His people.
The Lord God declares this.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּ֑ם וְהֵ֗מָּה עַמִּי֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: ‘You are My flock, the sheep of My pasture, My people, and I am your God,’ declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He declares this truth.
You are My flock.
You are the sheep of My pasture.
You are My people.
I am your God.
passages.original: וְאַתֵּ֥ן צֹאנִ֛י צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י אָדָ֣ם אַתֶּ֑ם אֲנִי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
